messages:
tia: rolling canary for textgen-service v6.7 -> v6.8. change window 30m, start 10% -> 40% if green. watch slo:textgen_p95 and error/5xx.

deploy-bot: canary started: textgen-service:v6.8 at 10%. monitors: slo/textgen_p95, metric/http_5xx_rate, route:/v1/generate 4xx/5xx.
sam: quick heads-up: v6.8 tightened prompt size limits; older clients may hit 413/4xx.

ops: seeing a tenant-scoped 413 surge for tenant=legacy-partners immediately after start (from ~0.02% -> 1.9%). p95 and 5xx otherwise stable.

tia: decision: pause roll at 10% and apply tenant pin for legacy-partners -> v6.7. @deploy-bot apply pin and hold.
deploy-bot: ack. tenant pin applied: legacy-partners -> textgen-service:v6.7. canary paused at 10%. audit event emitted.

alerts-bot: routed alert suppressed for tenant=legacy-partners while pin active. suppression expires when pin removed.
sam: I'll add a compatibility path to accept larger prompts for legacy-partners and add migration note to release notes.
tia: extending change window +1h to let team patch and rerun small smoke. will reconvene before resuming traffic. thanks all for quick triage :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Canary paused at 10% after prompt-size validation in v6.8 caused tenant-specific 413 spike; applied tenant pin to v6.7, team will patch and extend change window.
